choice_requirements: The value satisfies the executable pipeline contract.
The value is compatible with known dataset metadata, including the Nyquist limit.
At least one cited explicit observation normalizes to the selected executable value.
The investigator supplies a rationale and confirms the choice.
persistence: The project parameter record stores the decision id, evidence ids and corpus version.
The method decision stores the exact evidence snapshot used at decision time.
Changing a parameter invalidates the previous project validation.
The execution plan exposes the resolved records and their decision provenance.
